scope: Static javap inspection of pinned Minecraft and NeoForge-patched classes, not game execution

observations.inventory_save: main slots 0..35, armor 100..103, offhand 150 as byte; skip empty stacks; ItemStack.save with Player.registryAccess; main/armor/offhand order
observations.player_save: Direct saveWithoutId -> writeCompressed temporary -> Util.safeReplaceFile -> firePlayerSavingEvent. Method catches Exception, logs warning, returns void; return is not persistence acknowledgement.
observations.player_load: load .dat, with .dat_old fallback after failed primary; future coordinator must verify authoritative file and transaction marker before admission.
observations.entity_persistent_data: getPersistentData stored under root NeoForgeData; transaction marker belongs inside that compound.
observations.clone_persistent_scope: ServerPlayer.restoreFrom preserves only getPersistentData()[PlayerPersisted] before EventHooks.onPlayerClone; journal runner checks 15 pinned bytecode instructions. V2 transaction markers belong inside this subtree.

limitations: Static inspection does not validate actual Player, event hooks, transformed mod behavior, crash atomicity or power-loss persistence.
Proposal test uses Inventory(null), actual ItemStack codecs and fixture slot encoding; Inventory.save itself is not called.
Native PlayerDataStorage save differs from asynchronous SavedData.save; do not transfer that API assumption.
